decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.

decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.

decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.

decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.

decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.

decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.

decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.

decode_window.definition: first decode scheduler.run_batch start to latest decode batch host end/correlated kernel end; includes inter-batch gaps; excludes initial prefill and profiler stop/export, but may include interleaved prefill (see count)
decode_window.GPU_timeline_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes from first correlated decode GPU kernel start to last decode GPU kernel end, broken at prefill dispatch boundaries. Includes inter-round GPU gaps, excludes initial CPU dispatch and GPU queueing before first decode kernel, and excludes final host response work. Request-derived cycles cover end-to-end decode instead.
decode_window.segmented_definition: Union of consecutive decode-run envelopes, broken at every scheduler prefill batch. Each envelope starts at first CPU dispatch and ends at last correlated GPU kernel/host completion. Excludes between-wave API and prefill dispatch gaps; queueing of preceding GPU work can still overlap its beginning. This is a pipeline envelope, not isolated kernel latency.
